correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the all-m,n joint-moment event (not merely pointwise positivity) and checked it against Tian Theorem 4.1 for noncommuting 2x2 matrices. For A/||A||=rI+(1-r)P and B/||B||=sI+(1-s)Q, D has positive trace r+s and determinant rs-(1-r)(1-s)tr(PQ). Independent Haar complex lines give tr(PQ) uniform on [0,1]. Square 2x2 complex Wishart ordered eigenvalues imply f_R(r)=6(1-r)^2/(1+r)^4; using odds t=r/(1-r) gives 6/(1+2t)^4, and rational integration of min(1,ts) yields (24-28log2)/81. The partial fractions were checked independently numerically against the integral. Dimension 1 C=0 exponential-measure representation. For d>=3 Tian Eq(5.3) forces off-diagonal B_23=0 in an A-eigenbasis on a probability-one simple-spectrum/cyclicity event, a null event under the positive-definite Wishart density. This is almost surely not deterministic impossibility. Inspected RESULT.md blob 4b5a4daa86c9b2078bb3dfb01f5c6b88e9e540ba and Tian original PDF.
